title: Dillon Gabriel focused on "running my own race" in Browns QB competition

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Dillon Gabriel focused on "running my own race" in Browns QB competition
sources.description: When Browns head coach Todd Monken broke down the division of work for the team's quarterbacks at their first minicamp practice on Tuesday, he said that things would change every day and that the team set things up "in a way for us to get a look at all of" Shedeur Sanders, Deshaun Watson and Dillon Gabriel.
